# Introduction {-}
Here we present how the results shown in the manuscript were obtained starting from the raw data collected during the study. The dedicated [`sangchem`](https://github.com/TomVuod/sangchem) R package is available on GitHub and can be isstalled via:
```{r eval=FALSE}
if(!require(devtools)) install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("TomVuod/sangchem")
```
